2609.27554.title: PhyMo: A Physical-Field Modality for Multimodal AI4Physics
2609.27554.paper_summary: Multimodal learning is emerging as a powerful paradigm for AI for Physics (AI4Physics), where predicting physical systems requires the joint interpretation of heterogeneous observations, measurements, and domain knowledge. However, existing approaches typically represent physical quantities and governing equations as generic numerical or textual tokens, overlooking the physical constraints that determine their spatiotemporal interactions. To address this limitation, we introduce the \textbf{physical-field modality} and propose \textbf{PhyMo}, a physics-grounded multimodal framework that organizes heterogeneous measurements through PDE-associated operators. PhyMo follows a three-stage learning procedure: the physical-field encoder is first pretrained through field reconstruction under PDE residual supervision, its representations are subsequently aligned with visual embeddings in a shared latent space, and the fused multimodal representations are finally processed by corresponding downstream prediction heads. Experiments on five datasets spanning diverse physical environments show that PhyMo achieves state-of-the-art performance, compared to the strongest baseline on each dataset, demonstrating the superiority of PhyMo on multimodal representation learning in AI4Physics.
2609.27554.paper_summary_zh: 多模態學習正逐漸成為物理學人工智慧（AI4Physics）的一種強大範式，在這裡，預測物理系統需要對異質觀察、測量和領域知識進行聯合解釋。<lb/>然而，現有的方法通常將物理量和控制方程表示為通用的數值或文本標記，忽略了決定其時空互動的物理約束。<lb/>為了解決這一限制，我們引入了\textbf{物理場模態}，並提出了\textbf{PhyMo}，這是一個基於物理的多模態框架，通過與PDE相關的運算子組織異質測量。<lb/>PhyMo遵循三階段學習程序：物理場編碼器首先通過在PDE殘差監督下的場重建進行預訓練，然後其表示與共享潛在空間中的視覺嵌入對齊，最後融合的多模態表示由相應的下游預測頭進行處理。<lb/>在五個涵蓋不同物理環境的數據集上的實驗顯示，與每個數據集上最強的基線相比，PhyMo達到了最先進的性能，展示了PhyMo在AI4Physics中的多模態表示學習的優越性。
